reports.title: WHITE MOUNTAINS REPORTS THIRD QUARTER RESULTS

desk.headline: Book value per share down 1% to $2,243 as higher rates and MediaAlpha drop hit investments; loss of $17.71 a share; no guidance

other.label: Book value per share
other.change: -1% in Q3, +3% year to date (incl. dividends)

other.label: MediaAlpha mark-to-market
other.change: share price down 24% in the quarter

results: Higher interest rates and a 24% fall in MediaAlpha's share price led to $69m of net investment losses, including $54m on MediaAlpha.
Ark wrote $386m of gross premiums (up from $366m) at a 75% combined ratio. Its pre-tax income fell to $64m from $97m on investment losses. Iran war losses were $10m.
Kudu's adjusted EBITDA rose to $18m, but its revenue was negative as rates cut the value of its stakes. HG Global wrote a record $19m in premiums.
WTM Partners' revenue doubled to $107m after two acquisitions. Total revenue fell to $641m, partly because the year-ago figure included Bamboo, since sold.
Buybacks were $217m in the first nine months but minimal in Q3. On 4 Nov it agreed to sell 5.5m MediaAlpha shares at $13.90.

guidance.summary: White Mountains gives no financial guidance. It says about $0.8bn of capital is still not deployed.

watch: MediaAlpha's share price: after the sale, each $1 move shifts book value by about $5 a share
Interest rates, which drove marks on fixed income, Kudu's stakes and the BAM surplus notes
